why_this_file_exists: A frozen declaration is never edited. Defects found in the code written under it are recorded here.

defects.found: before the first run's results were read; the run was killed at 30 minutes and no number from it reached the manuscript
defects.what: The first implementation of arm C built its target structures by filtering M63.pairs_from_db's multi-family pairing map to the design window and re-emitting it as a single-family dot-bracket string. pairs_from_db parses ([{<ABCD, so the filtered map contains crossing (pseudoknotted) pairs; collapsing it to () and reparsing reassigns every crossing by stack order.
defects.measured_severity: All 20 targets carry crossings. Only 180 of 594 intended pairs (30.3%) survive the flattening; target P19 keeps 0 of 45, P14 keeps 5 of 35, P01 keeps 5 of 17. The optimiser was therefore designing for, and being scored on, structures that are mostly not the targets.
defects.prior_occurrence: This is the third time this exact flattening has been made in this project. M63's own erratum records it as F4: 'our first two implementations flattened the crossings into a dot-bracket that was balanced and wrong'. The balanced-but-wrong property is why no assertion caught it.
defects.second_defect_in_the_same_code: the admission threshold was written as len(Q) < 8 on a double-indexed map, admitting targets with 4 pairs where M63's own rule requires 8
defects.third_defect_in_the_same_code: the comparison baseline was M63's FULL designed corpus (n=160, whole molecules) rather than designed_core (n=104, the same nested-core pairs), so the arms would not have been scored on the same pair set
defects.repair: arm C now calls M63.nested_core, the same function M63's own C' control uses, so crossings are dropped rather than reassigned; the admission rule is len(Q)//2 >= 8; the designed arm is rebuilt on the same nested-core pairs; and the script verifies the harness by reproducing M63's published Cprime_repaired_control.designed_core before the optimiser runs.
defects.what_this_does_not_change: no prediction of the declaration is regraded, no arm is dropped, and S7 is still graded on the repaired run in the declaration's wording

defects.found: while running arm E, from a gate that disagreed with the published value on the same data
defects.what: M64's purchase engine computes a ONE-SIDED permutation p, (null >= d), while every published p in the frozen family comes from designaudit.core.contrast, which is TWO-SIDED, (|null| >= |d|). M64 therefore substituted one-sided values into a family whose other members are two-sided.
defects.why_nothing_caught_it: M64's equivalence gate compared the statistic and the null width, both of which are sidedness-blind, and every arm it bought sat at the permutation floor where the two conventions give the same number. cxP3 is the first purchased arm not at the floor, and it disagreed: one-sided 0.0165 against a published 0.0305, while two-sided reads 0.0310.
defects.measured_consequence: NONE. Re-derived on identical seeds, all five M64 arms reproduce their printed one-sided values exactly, confirming the diagnosis; four of the five give the same value two-sided (1e-6, 1e-6, 1e-6, 2e-6) because |null| never reaches |d|, and only eDTwoP moves, 7.0e-6 to 1.3e-5. With every purchased p two-sided the family of 42 still has Holm rejecting 7 and the membership is unchanged.
defects.repair: arm E reports both conventions and uses the two-sided one. No number in the manuscript changes. The defect is recorded because the convention was inconsistent, not because the answer was wrong.
defects.what_this_does_not_change: no stake of M64 is regraded and no figure in the manuscript is edited on account of E2

declared_but_not_run.text: 'and where available a free-energy-minimising search subject to the target structure'
declared_but_not_run.status: not run. ViennaRNA exposes no constrained free-energy-minimising designer beyond inverse_fold (structure constraint, early stop) and inverse_pf_fold (ensemble objective, no stop rule), both of which ARE run. The declaration's 'where available' is read as it is written; the absence is recorded here rather than left silent.
